<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/routes/{routeId}/attempts"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Records DELIVERED, FAILED or COLLECTED for one package on an OUT_FOR_DELIVERY route and publishes DeliveryAttempted. COLLECTED is valid only for a package inducted into the wave as a PICKUP (ADR 0017, activation-gated; every induction is DELIVERY until then). Errors: ErrRouteNotStarted (409 route-not-started), ErrAlreadyDelivered (409 already-delivered). A FAILED attempt counts in the package's attempt history and re-inducts the package onto the next wave (policy RetryNextWave); the third failure publishes PackageReturnInitiated instead. The attempt that records the last outstanding package completes the route, and the last completed route completes the wave.
